info.name: Get Execution Results by Block ID

params.name: block_id
params.description: Single ID or comma-separated list of block IDs.

params.name: select
params.description: A comma-separated list indicating which properties of the content to return.

params.name: agreeing_executors_count
params.description: A minimum number of execution receipts for the execution result.

params.name: required_executor_ids
params.description: A set of execution node IDs, one of which must have produced the execution result.

params.name: include_executor_metadata
params.description: Specifies whether or not to include the executor metadata in the response.

items.docs: Get execution result by provided block ID or multiple block IDs provided as comma-seperated list.
